name: Storyteller Special Edition
summary: Once upon a time — wait, what comes next again? Drag and drop classic characters onto the page to build surprising stories. This Special Edition includes new chapters and scenarios (like Frankenstein and Hansel & Gretel), post-game content as Jester Stamp Stories and quality-of-life improvements.
